purpose: A React hook that shows a page's data on the first render when the session cache holds it, revalidates behind it, and says when an update is running.
namedChanges: the import of the cache reads from the package "@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-session-cache" instead of "./sessionCache";
the first comment line loses its cycle tag; no code changed.

context forwarding (0.2.0): `useCached` calls the loader with the `LoadContext` the cache hands it, `(ctx) => loaderRef.current(ctx)`, on mount (`swr`) and in `refresh`, so a loader may call `ctx?.preview(value)`. It is not in Social's `useCached.ts`, so it is a change made in the unit before the source app has it (RuleGhsResync): keep it when the unit is re-synced. A loader that takes no argument behaves as before.
